Acceptance criteria checklist

Every acceptance criterion for this story, mapped to where it's demonstrated.

1

All three fixed leave types are listed for an employee — AC1

"Leave Types" always shows Annual, Sick, and Unpaid leave with no add/edit/delete control; the "Requesting time off" preview on that screen shows the same three as the options an employee picks from.

2

Completing onboarding gets a starting balance per type — AC2

On "Employee Balances", Priya Shah (onboarding completed, no balance yet) gets a "Set starting balances" action; saving records a balance for all three types at once.

3

No starting balance exists before onboarding is complete — AC3

Devon Ruiz (in progress) and Taylor Kim (not started) show "No starting balance yet" with no action available, on both "Employee Balances" and "Balance Lookup".

4

Current balance per leave type is shown in a request/approval view — AC4

"Balance Lookup" shows Jordan Reyes's, Sam Okafor's, and Morgan Ellis's current Annual/Sick/Unpaid balances — the view a request or approval screen would embed.

⚠

Open product decision — not an acceptance criterion

Who may set or adjust balances (HR only, or HR + Manager) is undecided. "Employee Balances" previews both options via its "Permission model" control; this must be settled before the story is scheduled for build.

Set starting balances

These are recorded once and used as the running balance — there's no accrual, carryover, or expiry in this story.
